description: The objective QC gate and delivery specs for a spoken-word mix (documentary, radio feature, podcast): dialogue-anchored loudness, true peak at 4x oversampling, LRA, dead air, clicks at cue edges, masking, level jumps, tonal balance, the transcription check of every narration cut, the half-volume test and the multi-system listen, with the thresholds and their sources (PRSS, ATSC A/85, EBU R128, Netflix, Torcoli/AES) and the opendubstage qc CLI. Use before any picture render, when someone asks "is this mix ready", "what loudness should this be", "why does the limiter still show overs", "is there a click here", "how do I check the cuts", or when writing a verify step / CI gate for a mix. Do NOT use for choosing processing (dialogue-editing-and-restoration) or music placement (music-under-narration).
